title: FerrumWhiteList
description: FerrumWhiteList is a server-side Minecraft mod that adds nickname-based whitelist access. Useful when the default whitelist is not enough. Commands: /ferrum whitelist help, on, off, add, remove, list.
body:
_FerrumWhiteList_ is a simple server-side whitelist mod created for Minecraft servers that need nickname-based access control.

![baner1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/910bfa830032f1a2010da6b3af84a9174b1f8b9b.jpeg)

It was made for servers where the default Minecraft whitelist is not suitable, especially offline-mode servers. Instead of relying only on account UUIDs, FerrumWhiteList checks player nicknames directly.

The whitelist is case-sensitive, so names like MAYDEX22 and maydex22 are treated as different players.

Commands:
/ferrum whitelist help - Shows the command list
/ferrum whitelist on - Enables the whitelist
/ferrum whitelist off - Disables the whitelist
/ferrum whitelist add <nickname> - Adds a player to the whitelist
/ferrum whitelist remove <nickname> - Removes a player from the whitelist
/ferrum whitelist list - Shows all whitelisted players

Config:
config/ferrum-whitelist.json

This mod is server-side only. Players do not need to install it on their client.
